original.target_description: Bersani and Doherty (2013), When the Ties That Bind Unwind. Original full text not acquired. No study, outcome, sample, or test locator supplied.

replication.target_description: Title-verified Adamkovic, Ropovik, and Banik secondary-data replication report, SCORE RR ID 6zz3k, OSF 8ndcx; supplied URL 5869t identifies its DOCX file. Report evaluates two distinct claims, g82z5k and moyz3d, including multiple models and a complex Wald test. Empty study/outcome/test locators prevent identifying the assigned effect.

reported_success.location: Claim evaluations, paragraphs 22–35; additional analyses, paragraphs 38–49

notes: Original acquisition: DOI landing returned HTTP 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex matched the supplied title but provided no open-access full-text location; exact-title/DOI searches found an abstract-only OJP record and a request-full-text ResearchGate record, with no verified accessible primary full text. Original coefficients quoted in the replication report were not treated as direct original-paper extraction. Replication full DOCX acquired and cached; its paragraphs 23 and 29 identify different original tests. No neutral description, study identifier, or locator in the blind input disambiguates them, so no candidate was selected and no overall success was inferred from significance. The replication report also contains inconsistent narrative wording in an additional analysis (paragraph 45).
